============================
 AfricaStage Pit Seeder CLI
============================
-h, --help			print out all options
-v, --version		print version info
-n, --nologo		do not display the banner
-b, --debug			enable debug output
-r, --pitroot		root directory containing pits
-c, --cloud			cloud provider name (looks up root in Os.Config)
-s, --source		source file for import (JSON or JSON5)
-e, --export		export directory for JSON output
--json				export to stdout (for piping to jq, grep, etc.)
--wwwa				operate on all 4 pits (Person, Object, Place, Activity)
<pit name>			pit to operate on (e.g., Person)

 PitRoot			(not set)
  Person			Person.pit
  Object			Object.pit
  Place				Place.pit
  Activity			Activity.pit
